newsitem.title: UK: Oasis star Liam escapes with drug caution.
newsitem.headline: Oasis star Liam escapes with drug caution.

text.p: Liam Gallagher of top rock group Oasis, known as the bad boy of British pop music, escaped prosecution for possessing cocaine on Tuesday when police contented themselves with warning him not to repeat the offence.

Gallagher, the 24-year-old singer with the million-selling band, was arrested in the early morning of November 9 after a night of celebrating Oasis's victory at a music awards ceremony in London. He was released on bail by police.

His arrest was the latest in a series of headline-grabbing antics surrounding Oasis, which has rocketed to success in the past three years to become the most successful British rock band since the Beatles in the 1960s.

Police said the rock star had received no special treatment. "It is common practice for first time offenders arrested for possession of small quantities of drugs for personal use, and who admit the offence, to be cautioned," a spokesman said.

Oasis, whose first two albums have sold 20 million copies, have led a "Britpop" revival. But the feuding between Liam and his brother Noel has generated as many headlines as the music. Oasis's record company Creation is 49 percent owned by Sony Music.
